title: Deprecated Features
description: Checks for deprecated features, blocks, and textures that may be removed in future Minecraft versions. Update deprecated content to ensure long-term compatibility.

101.title: Deprecated Block
101.description: Warning when overriding a deprecated vanilla block. The block may be removed in future versions, breaking your content.
101.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the deprecated block identifier

102.title: Deprecated Terrain
102.description: Warning when referencing a deprecated terrain texture name. Update to the current texture identifier.
102.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the deprecated terrain texture name

103.title: Deprecated Texture
103.description: Warning when using a deprecated texture path. Update to the current texture location.
103.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the deprecated texture path

104.title: JSON Parse Error
104.description: Error when a JSON file could not be parsed during deprecation checking.
104.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the JSON parse error message
